verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API and an MCP server that makes authenticated REST API calls, but nothing describing how to issue scoped, read-only, or least-privilege API keys for an agent. The read-only SDK Connection Endpoint is an adjacent feature: its payloads are public and need no authentication, so it is not a scoped API credential. Pricing-page 'Advanced permissioning' refers to access control generally and does not document scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
